Potato___Early_Blight.description: Early blight is a fungal disease that can affect potato leaves and cause dark lesions and premature loss of foliage.
management: Remove and destroy severely infected plant material.
Remove infected crop debris from the field.
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness where possible.
Monitor the crop regularly for new symptoms.
prevention: Monitor plants regularly for early symptoms.

Potato___Late_Blight.description: Late blight is a serious potato disease that can rapidly damage leaves and stems under favorable environmental conditions.

prevention: Remove visibly infected plant material promptly.

Corn___Common_Rust.description: Common rust is a fungal disease that produces rust-colored pustules on corn leaves.
management: Remove severely affected plant material where practical.
prevention: Choose suitable resistant varieties when available.

Corn___Gray_Leaf_Spot.description: Gray leaf spot is a fungal disease that causes characteristic lesions on corn leaves.
management: Remove or properly manage infected crop residue.

Rice___Leaf_Blast.description: Rice leaf blast is a fungal disease that can produce lesions on leaves and reduce crop productivity.

prevention: Monitor crops during favorable disease conditions.
